verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 is hardware you deploy in your own infrastructure. First-party docs describe a standard PCIe Gen5 card that integrates into existing servers over standard Ethernet, plus running the Gaudi Docker image on your own platform and serving models with vLLM and SGLang. A community comment adds that the open OAM interface allows non-proprietary hosting. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of on-prem deployments, documented procurement and pricing path for self-hosted purchase.
